A letter, never sent: "I hid the Brass Sextant in Kingsbarrow. Whoever finds this, take it to the harbour."

QuestItem.description: A ship's bell no bigger than a fist. It doesn't ring, though the clapper moves.
QuestItem.name: Drowned Bell

Clue.text: A letter, never sent: "I hid the Drowned Bell in The Pinewalk. Whoever finds this, take it to the harbour."
A trapper's tally stick, notched and abandoned, with a note: "3 more Golden Eagles and I'm paid."

log: You stand at The Town Gate.
A notice board by the gate has 3 notices pinned to it.
The Smithy is open for trade and takes crafting work.
⚑ The way into The Sallow Fens lies open.
⚑ Word comes from Gullhaven: with the way beyond open, worse things have woken in The Wrack Coast. 2 dread bounties are posted on its notice board.
You take down the notice: Dread: the Night-Born Cave Rat.
